name: Cøry "interpünkt" Solovewicz
biography: Cory Solovewicz (aka interpünkt) is a security consultant specializing in web and mobile application testing. His path into security started early, experimenting with tools like Sub7 and learning how systems could be pushed beyond their intended use. After a career in full-stack development, he transitioned into security to focus on breaking and improving real-world systems. He brings a builder’s perspective to his work, shaped by years of coding, late nights in hackerspaces, and a curiosity for how things fail.
